title: Strings made of digits with a leading zero
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as decimal integers (755, 7, 0, 123456789) and YAML 1.1 reads the ones made of octal digits as octal numbers, so a plain `0755` is a number whichever way it is read. As strings they are quoted.
